creandum-conduct-ai:ashbyhq:fbd76fa7-aaf.description: TL;DR: We're looking for exceptional ABAP engineers eager to build the AI layer for operating the world’s most complex IT setups. Teams collaborate alongside AI agents to accelerate their work, be it fit-gap analyses, hypercare support, deciphering business processes, writing ABAP, and more. We believe this is a generation-defining mission: by accelerating IT, businesses can evolve faster, unlocking productivity across industries. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we just closed a $50M+ Series A from top-tier funds, and we're still early enough that what you build here defines the company. You'll stand out if you: - Have 5+ years of hands-on ABAP and SAP development experience: technical consultant, ABAP developer, solutions architect, or similar - Understand how SAP systems are actually structured beneath the surface: data models, BAPIs, IDocs, function modules, enhancement frameworks - Have worked within or alongside large SAP implementations and migrations, understanding the complexities that arise from these - Are eager to work beyond ABAP, including in writing AI agents, backend and frontend, infrastructure, etc. - Bring strong, pragmatic engineering instincts and care about code that holds up in production at enterprise scale We hire the best, wherever they come from: we sponsor visas and are based in London. As an SAP specialist you’ll catch the edge cases, constraints, and quirks that only someone with that experience would spot.
